functions.name: dlisio.dlis.calibration.Calibration
functions.description:
Calibration objects are a collection of measurements and coefficients that
defines the calibration process of channel objects.

functions.name: dlisio.dlis.channel.Channel
functions.description:
A channel is a sequence of measured or computed samples that are indexed
against some physical quantity e.g. depth or time. The standard supports
multi-dimensional samples. Each sample can be a scalar or a n-dimensional
array. In addition to giving access to the actual curve-data, the Channel
object contains metadata about the curve.

functions.name: dlisio.dlis.coefficient.Coefficient

Comment objects contains arbitrary messages that may be interesting for the

functions.name: dlisio.dlis.computation.Computation

Results of computations that are more appropriately expressed as static

functions.name: dlisio.dlis.equipment.Equipment
functions.description:
Equipment objects contains information about individual pieces of surface
and downhole equipment used in the acquistion of the data. Typically, tools
(specified by the Tool object) is a composition of equipment.

functions.name: dlisio.dlis.file.LogicalFile.object
functions.description:
Direct access to a single object.
dlis-objects are uniquely identifiable by the combination of
type, name, origin and copynumber of the object. However, in most cases
type and name are sufficient to identify a specific object.
If origin and/or copynr is omitted in the function call, and there are
multiple objects matching the type and name, a ValueError is raised.

functions.name: dlisio.dlis.measurement.Measurement.minus_tolerance
functions.description:
The maximum value that any sample (in samples) can fall below the
reference and still be 'within tolerance'. Should be all non-negative
numbers. If this attribute is empty, the minus tolerance is implicity
infinite.

functions.name: dlisio.dlis.measurement.Measurement.plus_tolerance
functions.description:
The maximum value that any sample (in samples) can exceed the
reference and still be 'within tolerance'. Should be all non-negative
numbers. If this attribute is empty, the plus tolerance is implicity
infinite.

functions.name: dlisio.dlis.splice.Splice
functions.description:
Splice describes the process of concatinating multiple channels into one.
The concatination is defined by the zone objects, where the first zone
object corresponds to the first input channel and so on. The zones must be
mutually disjoint but the ordering is arbitrary::

functions.name: dlisio.dlis.tool.Tool
functions.description:
A tool is an ensembly of equiptment that as a whole provide measurements or
services. The list of equiptment that makes up the tool can be found in
*tool.parts*. Tools objects also keep a list of all channels that where produced by
the tool in *tool.channels*.
